# HexPiece 2.2.8

The Haki slash after your Marineford clip (the mint wave full of foam). Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks
and tests pass, and the slash was rendered from the game's own code and judged (`docs/images/haki-slash-energy.png`, GIF
`docs/images/haki-slash-flow.gif`).

## The slash: foam and ink
- **Foam cells**, like the clip: pale blobs ringed in a darker shade of your colour, born small at the cutting edge, swelling as they
  drift back along both flanks and rise, and popping before the tongues.
- **Inked edges**: the wave's silhouette and the tongues' torn edges get a darker line of your colour, as the anime draws it.
- **Fixed**: in 2.2.6 the wave's outer glow was drawn before the streaks and the white-hot cutting edge, and hid most of them (the
  game's glow layer blocks whatever is drawn after it behind it). They show now, and so does the foam.
- Still in your Ryou colour, still see-through, still flowing; its Haki crackle stays inked.

## Unchanged
The network protocol is the same as 2.2.1.
